source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added display test opens four opaque signed or signed-then-enveloped fixture names in sequence and checks for the Alice-to-Bob sentence in document text. It does not directly check HTML structure, exact line endings or signature validity. local-gen.sh adds copy steps for three missing browser fixtures, while the manifest packages data/**. The original was backed out; the fixed accepted test is present again with later certificate setup/cleanup. Keep fixture packaging, rendered-text assertions and cryptographic validity separate.
title: Opaque S/MIME display coverage checks rendered text rather than signature status
